tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Multilo product documentation by keyword. Returns matching pages with a one-line summary, the human URL, and a clean-Markdown URL suitable for fetching the full page. Use this first when asked how a Multilo feature works.

limit.description: Maximum results to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch any public Multilo page as clean Markdown — documentation, pricing, comparisons, blog posts, or the homepage. Accepts a path ('/pricing', '/docs/install/download') or a full multilo.com URL. Far cheaper and cleaner than fetching the HTML.

path.description: Site path or full multilo.com URL, e.g. '/pricing' or '/docs/install/download'.

tools.name: list_updates
tools.description: List the most recent Multilo changelog entries — shipped features, improvements and fixes, newest first. Use when asked what is new, whether something has shipped, or how recently the product changed.

limit.description: How many updates to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.
